lede: The School Board votes Tuesday on a flood-related budget appropriation for FY 2026-27 — real dollars tied to real damage at TIS, TMHS, and the Palm Theatre complex — and that's the item to watch this week. The Ethics Commission also meets Tuesday to work up a formal Code of Conduct recommendation for Town Council, a follow-on to the Commission's May finding that carries some weight. Rounding out the week, TMVOA takes up a Workforce Housing Committee and grant action on the TMV Ice Pad, and the County has a CCAP childcare funding discussion with budget implications worth understanding.

notable.stake: Board votes on flood-damage budget appropriation affecting district spending this year.
Commission develops Code of Conduct recommendation for Town Council officials.
County discusses CCAP childcare funding and its budget implications for San Miguel.
TMVOA votes on Workforce Housing Committee formation and TMV Ice Pad grant.
Hospital District may act on Two Site Model, shaping what gets built and where.
